Subject: Request: latency carveout + tiered discount for Summit Health SOW

Ben —

Thanks for the great conversation earlier. We are very close to signing the SOW but have two asks that are blockers for our procurement and platform teams:

1) Latency / uptime SLO: for our high-throughput clinical ingestion pipeline (peak nightly batches), we need a temporary SLO carveout — allow 99.8% monthly availability (vs your standard 99.9%) for the first 6 months on the model variant "inference-clinical-v2". This is to account for the unpredictable batch bursts while we ramp traffic.

2) Commit and discount: Summit can commit to a 12-month minimum with tiered monthly token commitments, but we need a volume-based discount schedule in the commercial terms: ~15% at >=500M tokens/month, 10% at >=300M tokens/month (these numbers are negotiable if you have constraints).

We attached the current SOW (v3) and a Q3 latency dump to explain the burst pattern. Procurement is asking for written approval from Redwood execs on both items before countersignature. Can you get back to us early next week? We are hoping to close by Nov 30.

Folks — forwarding Summit's ask (below). Deal context:
- ACV expected: $1.2M ARR (high growth expectation if they hit the 500M token tier).
- Close timeline: Nov 30 (procurement contingency for exec signoff).

Proposed commercial concessions (my recommendation to win quickly):
1) SLO carveout: temporary change to monthly availability target from 99.9% -> 99.8% for 6 months for the specified model and production cluster only; require telemetry (monthly SLO report) and an agreed mitigation plan.
2) Remedies: service credit only for unplanned downtime, capped at 15% of monthly invoice for any month (we should cap credits to limit revenue risk). No automatic right to early termination solely based on this temporary SLO change.
3) Tiered discount: 15% at >=500M tokens/month, 10% at >=300M tokens/month; discounts apply to inference usage only and require a 12-month commit. If they underdeliver vs commit, we true up at the end of the quarter.

Risks/asks: please confirm net revenue impact guardrail (finance) and legal language for the remedy cap and carveout. We should require that Summit provides an initial spike mitigation plan and accepts telemetry hooks (SLO dashboards).

Can you review and indicate: APPROVE / APPROVE WITH MODS / DENY. If APPROVE, note any changes and I will send a consolidated approval + redline to Summit.

Thanks — Ben

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: latency carveout + tiered discount for Summit Health SOW — exec approval request

Ben —

I reviewed the ask and the attached metrics. I am inclined to APPROVE with the following modifications to protect revenue and ops:

1) Remedies cap: reduce maximum service credit exposure to 15% of the monthly invoice (not 25%) — this aligns with precedent.
2) Discounts: offer 12% at >=500M tokens/month and 8% at >=300M tokens/month (slightly lower than requested). Finance must confirm the net revenue impact does not exceed a $200k annual hit to ARR.
3) Commitment & cancellation: require a 60-day notice for termination after the initial 12-month term (no 30-day cancellation).
4) SLO telemetry & mitigation: require Summit to grant read-only access to SLO dashboards and deliver a mitigation plan within 10 business days.
5) Legal: Lauren — please review and insert carveout language that explicitly states this is a temporary, model-specific exception and that standard remedies remain otherwise unchanged. Also confirm SOC2 evidence requirement in the SOW appendix.

If finance/legal are OK, I approve. Ben, please prep the SOW redline and SLO remedies addendum (include the telemetry requirement).

—Marissa

Elena / Mike —

Thanks for the patience. Executive review completed and we can accept the two non-standard items with the agreed guardrails. Summary of approved items (please review):

1) SLO Carveout (temporary): Redwood will permit a model-specific monthly availability target of 99.8% (in lieu of our standard 99.9%) for the model "inference-clinical-v2" on the specified hosted cluster for an initial period of 6 months from go‑live. This carveout is explicitly model-and-cluster-limited and is temporary.

2) Remedies cap & telemetry: Service credits for any qualifying downtime are allowed but capped at 15% of the affected month invoice. Summit must provide access to SLO dashboards (read-only) and deliver a spike mitigation plan within 10 business days of signing. Legal has drafted specific carveout language and will include it in the addendum.

3) Tiered discounts & commitment: We will offer the following usage discounts for inference usage only, conditional on the 12-month commitment:
   - 12% discount for >=500M tokens/month
   - 8% discount for >=300M tokens/month
If monthly usage falls below the committed tier, we will true-up at quarter end.

4) Term & cancellation: 12-month minimum commitment; thereafter 60-day notice for termination (no early cancellation during initial term).

Next steps: I attached the redlined SOW and the SLO remedies addendum for your review. If you confirm, we'll send a DocuSign amendment for signatures by next week. Also attaching the HubSpot deal link for reference.
